name: journal-selector
description: Journal Selector — turn 'where do I submit this paper?' into a reproducible, weighted decision matrix with cited evidence.

plugins.name: journal-selector
plugins.description: One skill, one command, one cheap retrieval subagent. Elicits your criteria and weights, fans out per-candidate fact-finding, scores the candidates deterministically via a bundled Python scorer, and writes a reviewable decision-matrix document.
